questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

196 : 226 :: 256 : 290 :: 324 : ?
questions.solution:
**Logic : (Square root of 1st number) + 1 = Square root of (2nd number - 1) **

So,

__
 
• 196 : 226

​ sqrt{196} + 1 = sqrt{(226 - 1)} 

14 + 1 = sqrt{225}

15 = 15 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 
• 256 : 290

​ sqrt{256} + 1 = sqrt{(290 - 1)} 

16 + 1 = sqrt{289}

17 = 17 (LHS = RHS)17 = 17

Similarly,

 
• 324 : ?

​ sqrt{324} + 1 = sqrt{(x - 1)} 

18 + 1 = sqrt{x - 1}

(19)² = x - 1

361 + 1 = x 

**x = 362**

Hence, **"362"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **Alternate Method__**

 
• 196:226 = 14² : (15²+1)
 
• 256:290 = 16² : (17²+1)
 
• Similarly,
 
• 324:362 = 18² : (19²+1)

Hence, "362" is the correct answer.

The ages of seven students of a tuition class, Prem, Qazi, Rishav, Subham, Tania, Urvashi and Vinita, are as follows:

Prem is the second oldest. Vinita is older than only one person in the class. Subham is older than Tania but younger than Prem. Three students are older than Tania and three are younger than Tania. Neither Rishav nor Qazi is the youngest.

Given that no two students have the same age, who is the youngest?
questions.solution:
**Given : **

 
• **Seven students of a tuition class → **Prem, Qazi, Rishav, Subham, Tania, Urvashi and Vinita.

**​Explanation :**

1) Prem is the second oldest. 

2) Vinita is older than only one person in the class.

_ > Prem > _ > _ > _ > Vinita > _

3) Three students are older than Tania and three are younger than Tania.

_ > Prem > _ > Tania > _ > Vinita > _

4) Subham is older than Tania but younger than Prem. 

_ > Prem > Subham > Tania > _ > Vinita > _

5) Neither Rishav nor Qazi is the youngest.

As neither Rishav nor Qazi is the youngest, so the only student is left is Urvashi who will be the youngest one.

As neither Rishav nor Qazi age is clear, therefore there are two possible answers:

**Rishav > Prem > Subham > Tania > Qazi > Vinita > Urvashi **

or,

**Qazi > Prem > Subham > Tania > Rishav > Vinita > Urvashi**

Thus, according to final two arrangements Urvashi is youngest in both the cases.

Hence, **"Urvashi"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pilots are cutes. 

All ballers are cutes.

**Conclusions:**

I. All cutes are ballers.

II. Some pilots are ballers.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fac77131fa6503c34e6b02dee24766c318773b12cdd1e749a0616402b389e781.png] 

 

Conclusions:

I. All cutes are ballers → Does not follow (As some pilots are cutes. So, it is possible but not definitely true therefore it does not follow)

II. Some pilots are ballers → Does not follow (As some pilots are cutes, all ballers are cutes. So, it is definitely false as there is not direct relation between pilots and ballers therefore it does not follow)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows..

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follows**".
